about_the_game:
Defeat Mekanions, the mechanical lifeforms consuming the entire world!

You are a new recruit of "Clan," a global organization. The Clan's mission is to eliminate Mekanions—mechanically-infested lifeforms appearing in dungeons that have emerged across the world!

Grow stronger by learning skills at your Clan branch, crafting custom equipment, and completing various missions! The stronger you become, the more powerful Mekanions you will face.

Features

Growth System Through Missions

Accept and complete missions from various NPCs at your Clan branch to accumulate accolades.

When you reach certain accolade thresholds, your Agent Rank increases along with your stats and skill points.

Additionally, completing specific missions unlocks new regions, sectors, and dungeons.

Dungeon Clearing Gameplay Structure

When you clear each dungeon, you obtain contribution, credits, cores, and materials.

Custom Equipment

Craft your own unique equipment using materials obtained from defeating Mekanions and rare cores.

The performance of your crafted equipment increases based on the materials and cores used, and you gain special options.

Diverse Skill Combinations

Express your unique character through various choices within the skill tree divided into common skills and weapon skills!

You can further enhance your unique style through special equipment options granted by cores.

Additional Content Variety

Grow even stronger through various additional content!

You must also prepare for the endless rifts that await at the end.
